title: The Ship That Never Left the Dock
note: All assets are public domain in the United States. Untouched originals; never overwrite. Rendered derivatives live in ../images/. Credits verified against holding-institution records.

assets.title: Photographic Exhibits of The Eastland (ship capsized on the Chicago River)
assets.archive: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
assets.creator: Unknown photographer; record creator U.S. District Court, Western District of Michigan (RG 21)
assets.license: Unrestricted (NARA). Public domain in the United States.
assets.credit: National Archives and Records Administration, NAID 281841
assets.depicts: The Eastland lying completely on its port side in the Chicago River, hull exposed, a few figures on the hull, small boats alongside.
assets.alt_text: A long passenger steamship lies completely on its side in a narrow city river, its dark hull exposed above the waterline. A few small figures stand on the upturned hull, and brick warehouses line the shore.

assets.title: Panoramic Photograph of The Eastland at port
assets.archive: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
assets.creator: Unknown photographer; record creator U.S. District Court, Western District of Michigan (RG 21)
assets.license: Unrestricted (NARA). Public domain in the United States.
assets.credit: National Archives and Records Administration, NAID 281840
assets.depicts: The Eastland upright at its dock, bow-on, showing the full height of its superstructure and two funnels.
assets.alt_text: A tall white excursion steamship with two funnels and several decks sits upright at a city dock, seen bow-on so its full height fills the frame.

assets.title: Eastland disaster: excursion boat overturned in Chicago River with passengers standing on upturned port side; many small boats assisting in rescue operations while crowds watch from shore
assets.archive: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, George Grantham Bain Collection
assets.creator: Bain News Service, New York City
assets.license: No known restrictions on publication (Library of Congress)
assets.credit: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division, George Grantham Bain Collection, LC-USZ62-30114
assets.depicts: Rescue underway: passengers standing on the upturned hull, many small boats assisting, crowds watching from shore.
assets.alt_text: Dozens of people stand on the exposed side of a capsized steamship while small rowboats and launches crowd the water around it. A dense crowd watches from the riverbank.

assets.title: View of Eastland taken from Fire Tug in river
assets.archive: Wikimedia Commons (1915 postcard, Max Rigot Selling Company)
assets.creator: Max Rigot Selling Company, Chicago (publisher)
assets.license: Public domain in the United States (published before 1931)
assets.depicts: The capsized Eastland seen from a fire tug in the river, showing the scale of the hull against the river walls.
assets.alt_text: A huge dark hull fills the frame at water level, seen from a boat on the river. The overturned steamship's curved side rises above the water beside a stone river wall.

assets.title: Capsizing of the SS Eastland, as witnessed by Satterfield
assets.creator: Bob Satterfield (1875-1958)
assets.license: Public domain in the United States (published before 1931)
assets.credit: Bob Satterfield, The Tacoma Times, July 27, 1915
assets.depicts: Eyewitness drawing of the Eastland rolling over, with figures on the decks and in the water.
assets.alt_text: A dramatic black-and-white newspaper drawing shows a large steamship tilting sharply toward the water as tiny figures scramble on its decks and swim below, watched from a bridge.

assets.title: Chicago Tribune photographs of Eastland disaster mourners
assets.creator: Chicago Tribune staff photographers
assets.license: Public domain in the United States (published before 1931)
assets.depicts: A newspaper montage of five photographs showing women in period dress grieving, several holding handkerchiefs to their faces.
assets.alt_text: A row of five black-and-white newspaper photographs shows women in long skirts and wide hats, several pressing handkerchiefs to their faces as they grieve.

assets.title: The wreck of the Eastland

assets.creator: Kaufmann, Weimer & Fabry Co., Chicago

assets.depicts: A wide sepia panorama of the Chicago River at the wreck site, with the capsized hull, crowded banks, a bridge, and vessels.
assets.alt_text: A wide sepia photograph shows a city river crowded with boats and onlookers, with the exposed hull of a capsized steamship beside a bridge and tall warehouses.
